title: Enzonic Licensing
description:
A mod that adds licensing to minecraft!
Want to go mining? Well you need a mining license!
body:
## Enzonic Licensing adds 6 different licenses to the game:
- Driving License
- Mining License
- Buisness License
- Hunting License
- Farming License
- Building License

## Guide:
## 1. Crafting a memory card, printer and a licenser
![Crafting for licenser](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aba8eeecc4caf9e07af80fb86068e6bdf7aeeb02.png)
![Crafting for memory card](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d81b20b114d9ffa6e880cfccd159ccc809f650f.png)
![Crafting for printer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e15e0ebbdcb0c114a90fc503e0e3add76e7b3b79.png)
## 2. Write on the card
1. Right click the licenser, it opens a menu
2. put the memory card in the memory card slot
3. select a license you want
![The licenser gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d01107101e8fbf9ec5f851d7a7d6644f795ee16.png)
## 3. Print the license
1. Right click the printer, it opens a gui
2. Put paper in the paper slot and your written memory card in the memory card slot
3. Click print!


![Printer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07b89da0927001ee3fd55ef7c93c1c8710650e2f.png)
